attributes.long_name: Dissimilarity index to cells with mammals GBIF records, in the space of canopy height, above-ground biomass, BIO1 and BIO12 (standardised)
attributes.comment: No CF standard name exists for this quantity (CF standard name table v95, checked 2026-09-29). After Meyer & Pebesma 2021 doi:10.1111/2041-210X.13650; cells with a value above aoa_threshold are outside the area of applicability of the in-situ records.
